translations.web: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
translations.bsb: For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed? I will not yield My glory to another.
translations.kjv: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
translations.asv: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? and my glory will I not give to another.
